description: Energy Demand and Renewable Supply Dataset for Pacific Island Countries (EDRS-PIC) is a data set described in the paper "Energy Demand and Renewable Supply Dataset for Pacific Island Countries (EDRS-PIC)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2026), produced by Akash Jyoti Handique, Rebecca A. M. Peer, Gabriel Lopez and colleagues. Current and future energy demand and supply datasets of countries are used in analyzing and quantifying future energy transition pathways to mitigate global temperature rise. Coverage: 14 Pacific island countries. The data are held on Zenodo, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support energy transition pathway modelling for small island states. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
